name: Non-highlight colors handling
definition: A technique to handle view-dependent lighting that is not a sharp highlight (i.e., does not have a clear Lambertian and view-dependent component) by using a low-frequency function per voxel to approximate outgoing radiance, helping distinguish surface points from arbitrary volume points.
summary: Non-highlight colors handling distinguishes surface from volume points using per-voxel low-frequency environment maps and Cauchy loss to resolve shape-radiance ambiguity.
